source_text: Regarding fertility, while scarring from infibulation can theoretically obstruct menstrual flow or facilitate ascending infections potentially linked to tubal damage, a case-control study of 603 Sudanese women found no significant association between childhood FGM and primary infertility after adjusting for confounders (odds ratio ≈1.0).
